# Copilot instructions

Shared working agreements for this project are in `AGENTS.md` at the repository root. Follow them. Stack conventions load from `.github/instructions/*.instructions.md` when matching files are open.

The Aesir specialist agents (mimir, tyr, vidar, thor, ull, baldur, aegir, saga, volva) appear in the agent picker once they have been synced into `.github/agents/` or `~/.copilot/agents/`. Pick the specialist whose role fits, or describe the task in plain language.
